title: Pet medium dishes what she's learned about the unexplained ahead of Halloween
excerpt: EXCLUSIVE: Ahead of Halloween famous psychic and pet medium Angel Morgan has shared an inside look at what she's learned about the unexplained after 30 years in a career connecting to the spiritual realm
content:
EXCLUSIVE: Ahead of Halloween famous psychic and pet medium Angel Morgan has shared an inside look at what she's learned about the unexplained after 30 years in a career connecting to the spiritual realm

05:00 ET, 17 Oct 2026

With Halloween quickly approaching, famous psychic and pet medium Angel Morgan has shared what she's learned about unexplained after three decades working to understand the spiritual realm.

‌

‌

For the past 30 years Angel has built a massive following becoming one of North America’s most recognizable psychic mediums, paranormal experts and pet mediums/animal communicators. Through her psychic readings, mediumship, paranormal work and animal communication she has built an expansive knowledge of the spiritual world.

Now, in an exclusive interview with The Mirror US, Angel has shared what really happens during a psychic or mediumship reading, if animals can really communicate with their owners after death, and more. This comes after paranormal investigator Colin Bowen shared an inside look at his ghost hunting experiences.

‌

Angel explained that her interest in becoming a pet medium came after a medicine man in Guatemala told her that her calling was to "talk to animals and make a difference in the world." At the time she was skeptical, but after attending a workshop and diving deeper into the practice, found a deep passion and interest in the topic.

After taking advanced courses, Angel dedicated her life to learning more about the spiritual world and how to connect grieving pet owners with their lost furry friends. As most people have lost a pet they've loved deeply in their lives, Angel has been able to give owners the life-changing closure and connection to many.

‌

When asked if animals can really communicate after death, Angel explained, "Yes, because energy is energy, they can 'speak' as freely when they are living as when they are crossed over. It’s not always words or voices I hear, sometimes I can communicate with them through feeling, images, thoughts, and physicality (which is the one level of communication we are all used to)."

She added, "When an animals cross over the only level that is removed from the scenario is the physical. There is no body language to read, it’s now about tapping in to the pure spirit of who they were."

Sharing the messages that are usually shared from pets that have passed away, Angel shared, "Unless there is an urgent message, usually the first thing a pet will say is thank you. Thank you for their lives and thank you for helping in their process of letting go of this life. Many pet families hold guilt when they make the decision to assist in their transition. I find a lot of animals bring their families to me so they can let them know they are ok, and that the decisions that were made were not solely their families making them."

‌

She continued, "We are always connected, they give us feelings and knowings. They are part of the decision-making process, whether we are conscious of it or not. I also find that animals come to let their families know that it’s OK to let them go and to help bring in a new pet."

Over the years, Angel has noticed a pattern of pet owners feeling anxiety over "replacing" their lost pets, but she has assured that most animals do not feel hurt by this.

‌

She explained, "There is always so much anxiety over whether or not we are betraying our pet pals. Most times those who have gone before us want their best friends to be happy knowing they can welcome another cat, dog, bird, or reptile. Usually when a new animal arrives the deceased pet will be around to 'train' them in."

Angel also revealed that pets are very connected to the spiritual world, even moreso than humans.

She shared, "Because they are connected to their 5 psychic senses in ways we are only beginning to remember. Animals have the ability to see the unseen, whether it is a human, another animal, or something else. When I am on a paranormal investigation, they are the first ones I go to. If you want to know anything about a family or a situation ask the pet. They are the silent witnesses whether they are deceased or alive."

Some of the most common questions Angel says former pet owners want to know about their deceased animals include: How are they doing? What could we have done differently to make their lives better or their transition smoother? Do they know we loved them? Will they come back to us? (reincarnate) And were they happy?

During the Halloween season, Angel shared that there's a renewed interest in the spiritual world which is something she encourages and is happy to discuss. She shared, "Even though we love it year round, we are also putting all of our collective energy there."

Angel added, "Halloween people shine at this time of year! It’s really one of the only seasons that the weird kids are kool kids! It’s a sacred holiday to certain sects of society. Witches celebrate Samhain, this is their new year. Some of us do ancestor alters and dead dinners. Those people are Halloween minded all year round."

Angel encourages anyone interested in connecting with their deceased pets or to pursue their own career in the space to reach out and connect with her. She said, "If anyone would like to know more about me and what I do they can visit my website raisingenergy.com and I do so much through social media, specifically Instagram, where I give tips and techniques on how to grow your own confidence in this world!"
